market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $115 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$103 on May 5, needs to reach $115 in May (~11.5% rise). Already tested swing high near $110 amid Iran/UAE tensions and Strait of Hormuz disruption. EIA forecasts Brent peak ~$115 in Q2; WTI trades $5-6 below Brent. With ongoing geopolitical risk premium, $115 plausible but requires further escalation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran-US ceasefire status and Strait of Hormuz reopening timing
